div.head: II Cn 21
div.ab: Ac we wyllað, þæt ælc man ofer XIIwintre sylle þone að, þæt he nelle þeof beon ne þeofes gewita.
⁊ we wyllað, þæt ælc man ofer twelfwintre sylle þonne að, þæt he nelle þeof beon ne ðeofes gewita.
Uolumus, ut omnis homo post XII. etatis suę annum iuret, quod fur esse nolit nec furi consentaneus.
Be ðeofan. We wyllað þæt ælc man ofer twelfwintre sylle þone að, þæt he nyle ðeof beon ne ðeofes gewita.
Ac we wyllað þæt ælc man ofer XII wintre sylle þone að þæt he nelle þeof beon ne þeofes gewita.
Concerning thieves. It is our desire that everyone, over twelve years of age, shall take an oath that he will not be a thief or a thief's accomplice.
But we desire that each person over the age of twelve give their oath that they will be neither a thief nor a thief ’s accomplice.
And it is our will that every man over twelve years of age is to give an oath that he will not be a thief or accessory to a theft.
(Von Dieben. B) Und (Aber G) wir wollen, dass jeder mehr als zwölfjährige Mann folgenden Eid leiste: dass er weder Dieb noch Diebes Mitwisser sein wolle.
(Of thieves. B) And (But, G) we will that every man over twelve years old swear this oath: that he will be neither a thief nor an accessory to a thief.
div.note: G's ‘Ac’ is perhaps wrongly taken from the beginning of the previous sentence. B's heading is red. Liebermann compares the Instituta 7 and Ld.
